tagline: An independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company focused on the Permian Basin.
hero_kpi_rationale: Combined production volume (BOE/d) is the primary growth driver for Diamondback, reflecting the impact of Endeavor and Double Eagle acquisitions and organic development in a context of strong production expansion (+54% in 2025).

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of oil, natural gas, and natural gas liquids.
kpis.description: Revenues increased 33% in 2025 to $13.453 billion, driven by 54% growth in combined volumes, despite a 13% decline in oil prices.
kpis.signal: 33% revenue growth driven by strong production increase.

kpis.name: Combined Production Volumes
kpis.explanation: Total production in barrels of oil equivalent per day.
kpis.description: Combined production reached 921,036 BOE/d in 2025, up sharply driven by Endeavor acquisition (41% of incremental volume) and Double Eagle (12%), plus new wells (42%).
kpis.signal: 54% year-over-year jump driven by acquisitions and new well drilling.

kpis.name: Oil Production
kpis.explanation: Quantity of oil produced each day.
kpis.description: Oil production increased from 336,954 to 497,156 barrels per day in 2025, representing 54% of total combined volume.
kpis.signal: Oil production up 48%, key driver of growth.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin estimated at 32.1% in 2025 (vs 34.5% in 2024), reflecting acquisition integration and $579M increase in operating costs for acquired assets.
kpis.signal: High margin despite commodity price volatility and acquisition impact.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on new wells and infrastructure.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures totaled $7.809 billion in 2025, down from $11.221 billion in 2024 (Endeavor acquisition year). Company guidance for 2026: $2.0-2.2B LOE.
kpis.signal: Capex lower following major acquisition year (Endeavor) in 2024.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount increased to 2.5K employees in 2025 (vs 2.1K in 2024), primarily due to full-year Endeavor acquisition (2025) and compensation increases (+$47M).
kpis.signal: Headcount growth linked to Endeavor and Double Eagle acquisitions.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $71.06B in latest year.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $14.88B in latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue on annual basis, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 7 fiscal years from filed 10-Ks.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated net income on annual basis, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years from filed 10-Ks.
kpis.signal: Net income of $1.664B in latest year.

kpis.name: Realized Oil Price
kpis.explanation: Average price received per barrel of crude oil.
kpis.description: Average oil price declined from $73.52 to $64.04 between 2024 and 2025, a 13% decrease that partially offset the positive impact of 54% volume growth.

kpis.name: Oil and Gas Property Impairment
kpis.explanation: Non-cash loss on the value of oil reserves (SEC ceiling test).
kpis.description: Non-cash impairment charge of $3.652 billion in 2025 (vs $0 in 2024) resulting from decline in SEC oil prices. Company expects material additional impairment in Q1 2026 due to further price declines.
kpis.signal: Significant impairment charge driven by oil price decline in Q4 2025.

risks.title: Volatility in oil and natural gas prices
risks.score_rationale: The company is entirely dependent on commodity prices for oil and natural gas, which are highly volatile. A 13% decline in oil prices in 2025 despite 54% volume growth illustrates this systemic risk. The company took a $3.7B impairment charge in Q4 2025.

risks.title: Dependence on capital markets for financing
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on capital markets to finance major acquisitions (Endeavor, Double Eagle) and its CAPEX program ($7.8B in 2025). Access to credit and interest rates are essential to its expansion strategy.

risks.title: Credit and leverage risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has issued Senior Notes due 2026, 2029, 2031, 2051 and maintains credit facilities to finance acquisitions. Credit ratings influence refinancing costs and operational flexibility.

risks.title: Environmental regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Although not explicitly detailed in the excerpt provided, E&P operations are subject to federal and state environmental regulations (Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma) concerning emissions, wastewater, and site remediation.

risks.title: Reserve replacement and drilling productivity dependence
risks.score_rationale: The growth model depends on proved reserve replacement and production increases from new wells (42% of 2025 growth). Drilling success rates and development costs are critical.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed major acquisitions (Endeavor, Double Eagle) with transaction costs of $105M in 2025 and $303M in 2024. Operational integration and contractual compliance present risks.

risks.title: Liquidity and cash flow management risks
risks.score_rationale: Operating cash flow is sensitive to price volatility ($8.758B in 2025 vs $6.413B in 2024). The company must fund significant CAPEX ($7.8B) and manage debt obligations while maintaining adequate liquidity.

ai_positioning.summary: Diamondback Energy does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing for fiscal year 2025.
